correctness.rationale: Variation of constants proves the unique bounded lift; compactness proves injectivity of projection; the graph integral converges uniformly on compact base sets. The variational cocycle has an invariant vertical line with exact exponent -b and quotient equal to the base cocycle. Compact trajectories cross x=0 transversely, so the piecewise-C1 variational argument is valid. The packaged symbolic verifier confirms the block Jacobian and characteristic-polynomial factorization on both smooth branches.

value.rationale: The stable-filter conjugacy changes the interpretation of the fourth state from an added source of recurrent complexity to a slaved observable.
